observations.failure: The initial implementation required every auxiliary correspondence value to be finite; GenWarp emitted non-finite correspondence outside valid warp support.

diagnosis_after_retry.root_cause: Official half-precision execution also performs projective geometry in float16. Very distant off-screen points overflow before soft splatting, while the official invalid predicate checks depth only.

resolution: Keep official weights and diffusion network in float16, but run only projective geometry and soft splatting in float32; retain the strict visible-correspondence finite gate and rerun in a new output directory without overwriting.
